questions.question: In August 2026, what was the average residential electricity price in Hawaii, in cents per kilowatt-hour?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Hawaii'].index[0]
result = float(df.iloc[row, 1])

questions.question: Among the states in the New England division, which one had the highest residential electricity price in August 2026?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
states = ['Connecticut', 'Maine', 'Massachusetts', 'New Hampshire', 'Rhode Island', 'Vermont']
sub = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(states)].copy()
sub[1] = pd.to_numeric(sub[1])
result = sub.loc[sub[1].idxmax(), 0].strip()

questions.question: Which three Census divisions had the highest average electricity prices across all sectors in August 2026?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
divisions = [
    'New England', 'Middle Atlantic', 'East North Central', 'West North Central',
    'South Atlantic', 'East South Central', 'West South Central', 'Mountain',
    'Pacific Contiguous', 'Pacific Noncontiguous'
]
sub = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(divisions)].copy()
sub[9] = pd.to_numeric(sub[9])
top3 = sub.sort_values(by=9, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [x.strip() for x in top3[0].tolist()]

questions.question: How many states in the East North Central division had an average industrial electricity price under 10 cents per kilowatt-hour in August 2026?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
enc_states = ['Illinois', 'Indiana', 'Michigan', 'Ohio', 'Wisconsin']
sub = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(enc_states)].copy()
sub[5] = pd.to_numeric(sub[5])
result = int((sub[5] < 10.0).sum())

questions.question: Did the U.S. national average electricity price across all sectors increase from August 2025 to August 2026?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'U.S. Total'].index[0]
p_2026 = float(df.iloc[row, 9])
p_2025 = float(df.iloc[row, 10])
result = "yes" if p_2026 > p_2025 else "no"

questions.question: What was the average industrial electricity price across the four West South Central states in August 2026, in cents per kilowatt-hour?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('eia_epm_average_price_by_sector_and_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Table_5_06_A', header=None)
wsc_states = ['Arkansas', 'Louisiana', 'Oklahoma', 'Texas']
sub = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(wsc_states)].copy()
sub[5] = pd.to_numeric(sub[5])
result = round(float(sub[5].mean()), 2)
